caa65535-c09a-4a46-9ac7-30947b815020.title: Chiisakute Kawaii Bungeibu no Chiteki na Senpai o, Hiza no Ue ni Nosetara Mainichi Suwattekuru you ni natta
caa65535-c09a-4a46-9ac7-30947b815020.altTitle: After I Let The Small And Cute Intellectual Senior Of The Literature Club Sit On My Lap, She Started Sitting There Every Day
caa65535-c09a-4a46-9ac7-30947b815020.description:
One day, the chairs in the Literature Club were lent out to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind.
Kakeru and Yuzu began a lighthearted argument, each trying to yield the remaining seat to the other.
Each wanted the other to sit more than themselves. Because of their mutual kindness, neither would back down, resulting in a stalemate—until finally, Yuzu’s opinion won out, and Kakeru ended up sitting in the chair alone.
Kakeru felt guilty being the only one sitting, but right then, he had a flash of inspiration.

“Since I'm the one sitting in the chair, if I become the chair and let Yuzu-senpai sit on my lap… wouldn't that work?”

…Or so he thought.

d5dccaff-1727-4c20-9ab1-1d1b2bf330a2.title: Ota-kun ni dake Yasashisugiru Ayame-san
d5dccaff-1727-4c20-9ab1-1d1b2bf330a2.altTitle: Ayame-san Is Too Kind, But Only To Ota-kun
d5dccaff-1727-4c20-9ab1-1d1b2bf330a2.description:
In a “shitty rural” school where simply being an otaku makes you a target of bullying, Ota, a boy who loves idols, is inexplicably doted on by Ayame-senpai, a girl renowned for her beauty. 
Ota, who is routinely subjected to violence from his classmates and insulted by his parents as a disgrace to the family, and lives a miserable life. Understandably, he is confused by Ayame-senpai's sudden advances.
What exactly is she thinking? A “terrifying romantic comedy” unfolds, with a mixture of sweetness and horror!

cef6253d-6a55-4438-921c-46968b426f2f.title: Uchi no Kaisha no Chiisai Senpai no Hanashi
cef6253d-6a55-4438-921c-46968b426f2f.altTitle: Story of a Small Senior in My Company
cef6253d-6a55-4438-921c-46968b426f2f.description:
"My senpai from work... is tiny and cute."

Shinozaki is an office worker who is taken care of and coddled by his senior team member Shiori Katase: a gorgeous, profoundly kind, loving, and diminutive woman. Shinozaki certainly hopes that she's not doing it out of duty... but her joy of doing so increasingly exposes her feelings!
___
**Note:** This page refers to the popular webcomic's official serialization, which began on the Storia DASH website on April 3, 2020.

b40483ce-e448-4671-a84e-b2ea8fef938a.title: Dungeon de Tatakaitsuzukete 20-nen no Doutei Yuusha, Chijou ni Modottara Danjoubi 1:1000 no Sekai datta
b40483ce-e448-4671-a84e-b2ea8fef938a.altTitle: The Virgin Hero Who Fought in the Dungeon for 20 Years Returned to the Surface Only to Find the Population of the World Has Dropped Drastically, with a Male-to-Female Ratio of 1:1000
b40483ce-e448-4671-a84e-b2ea8fef938a.description:
The legendary hero Ryuuto, who vanished into the depths of a Dungeon to subjugate the Demon King, wandered inside for 20 years before returning to the surface. However, the world he returned to was one where the male population had plummeted due to the Demon King's curse, and women's sense of chastity had drastically changed. Every woman he meets is a beauty, and what's more, they all approach Ryuuto. While Ryuuto unintentionally charms those around him and causes commotions, he senses the shadow of the Demon King in the monsters emerging from the Dungeon and throws himself back into the battlefield.
___
**Character Designer:** [HEIROU](https://mangadex.org/author/4065219c-84d7-466a-a52a-27f99668c564)

e5f13b1a-eabd-4752-863a-cc3930a20d24.title: A Sharp-Eyed Classmate
e5f13b1a-eabd-4752-863a-cc3930a20d24.description:
With her fierce eyes and sharp impression, and wary of everyone, 'Ahn Se-young' is a woman to watch out for.
Everyone is cautious around her, but a lone boy stands in front of her.
"I like you, go out with me!"
"......What?!"
Se-young is taken aback at the sudden confession of love, but this was just the beginning...
The tug-of-war between 'Ahn Se-young', who shows an unexpected side to her as you get closer, and 'Nam Ho-yeol', the straightforward guy who tries to break down her impenetrable facade, begins now!

6ab99945-f7f2-41d3-8060-bcfbefe32b84.title: Koibumi to 13-sai no Actress
6ab99945-f7f2-41d3-8060-bcfbefe32b84.altTitle: A Love Letter and a 13-Year-Old Actress
6ab99945-f7f2-41d3-8060-bcfbefe32b84.description: Fumi Isshiki works as an accountant at an entertainment agency. One day he is transferred to the management department, where Ayano Haga, a 13-year-old child actress, seems to take a liking to him... She is just a child, yet she acts more mature than many adults.

35b35c45-dde0-4805-995f-db862dc2810a.title: Sensuishi to Kurage
35b35c45-dde0-4805-995f-db862dc2810a.description: In one particular town in France, a waiter who feels like he’s stuck at the bottom of the sea meets a free-spirited pâtissier. Across the world, on a frozen tundra, a boy searching for his father meets a scientist and a man with the look of a snowy owl.

da36a727-7686-4e92-8fac-94bc292b8e91.title: Toshokan no Daimajutsushi
da36a727-7686-4e92-8fac-94bc292b8e91.description: In a distant world reminiscent of Arabian Nights, a mysterious young elf-child etched by a difficult life in the slums of a remote village with his elder sister. One day, he encountered Sedona, a librarian from the greatest library of the land, and the two formed a bond as they began their adventure in a fantastic and wondrous world.

fc25ce20-c979-4838-8674-b0a0718a3c0f.title: Aim for the Ace!
fc25ce20-c979-4838-8674-b0a0718a3c0f.description:
Oka Hiromi, a freshman at Nishi High, joins the school's prestigious tennis club because of her admiration for Madame Butterfly. Despite her clumsiness, Coach Munakata recognizes her potential and chooses her for the next competition.

Hiromi's unexpected promotion earns her the disapproval of her fellow tennis club members. But with the support of student council president Toudou Takayuki, she begins a rigorous training program under Coach Munakata.
